designDecisions.idColumn: text PRIMARY KEY, CHECK id ~ '^[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}$' -- canonical uppercase ULID: the first base32 character is restricted to 0-7 (the 48-bit millisecond timestamp's top 3 bits are always zero), the remaining 25 draw from the full Crockford alphabet. Repaired from an initial 26-character-unrestricted-first-char pattern.
designDecisions.hashColumns: entry_hash text NOT NULL CHECK ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'; prev_hash text NULL, same pattern when present.
designDecisions.payloadBindingFailClosed: Repaired: id/prevHash/requestActor.tenantId bindings now each require the JSON key present (jsonb `?`) and the expected JSON type (jsonb_typeof), and the value-equality comparison (where one applies) is wrapped `IS TRUE`; together the key/type guards and the wrapped equality make the whole CHECK expression fail closed, so a missing key or wrong type is a CHECK violation rather than a SQL NULL the CHECK would silently pass. Genesis requires the JSON key 'prevHash' actually present with jsonb_typeof = 'null' (no equality comparison applies there); a successor requires it present as a JSON string equal to the prev_hash column.
designDecisions.selfLinkRejection: CHECK (prev_hash IS NULL OR prev_hash <> entry_hash), independent of the payload-agreement checks.
designDecisions.chainIntegrity: UNIQUE (tenant_id, entry_hash) plus a self-referencing FK (tenant_id, prev_hash) -> (tenant_id, entry_hash) rejects any prev_hash naming a hash never written, scoped per tenant.
designDecisions.singleThreadedChain: Partial unique index on (tenant_id) WHERE prev_hash IS NULL caps one genesis per tenant; on (tenant_id, prev_hash) WHERE prev_hash IS NOT NULL caps one successor per predecessor.
designDecisions.rls: ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, one FOR ALL USING/WITH CHECK policy on tenant_id = mfk_current_tenant(), reusing S1's attestation mechanism.
designDecisions.grants: SELECT, INSERT only to the runtime role -- no UPDATE/DELETE, matching audit_log's grant shape.
designDecisions.appendOnlyTrigger: Dedicated statement trigger mfk_policy_decision_log_append_only, BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE, always raises -- blocks the owning role too, mirroring 0001's pattern with its own function.
designDecisions.migrationChain: down_revision = '0002_customer_records'; downgrade() drops only this revision's trigger, function and table.
